g.title: deploying neural networks edge devices often bottlenecked tight memory
g.desc: Deploying and training neural networks on edge devices is often bottlenecked by tight memory.
g.text: Training and inference on edge hardware is
bottlenecked above all by tight memory.

g.title: tensor rematerialization recomputing intermediate tensors instead storing trades compute peak memory
g.desc: Tensor rematerialization, recomputing intermediate tensors instead of storing them, trades extra compute for lower peak memory.
g.text: storing them: trade compute for peak memory.

g.title: introduces moccasin new constraint programming formulation minimizing execution time under memory budget
g.desc: This paper introduces Moccasin, a new constraint programming formulation for the problem of minimizing execution time under a memory budget.
g.text: Minimize execution time under a fixed

g.title: unlike prior work needs quadratic boolean variables moccasin linear integer variables scales order magnitude faster
g.desc: Unlike prior work that needs a quadratic number of Boolean variables, Moccasin uses only a linear number of integer variables, letting it scale to much larger compute graphs and run up to an order of magnitude faster.
g.text: Quadratic Boolean variables become a linear
number of integer variables — scaling further.
